components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneDigits"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same
            last name and address (i.e. they share a household). Write-only request flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

              readOnly: true

## What I implemented

`namesakeCount` — for each newly created owner, the number of owners that already existed sharing the same `firstName` **and** `lastName`, compared case-insensitively — is now computed at create time, persisted, and returned on the owner representation.

## Changes

1. **`ClinicServiceImpl.createOwner`** — computes and stamps the count before persisting, so it never counts the owner itself. Added a small single-responsibility helper `countNamesakes(Owner)` that reuses the existing `OwnerRepository.findByLastNameIgnoreCase` query (already used by the household check) and filters by case-insensitive first name. No new repository method or code duplication.

2. **`Owner` model** — new persisted `namesake_count` column (`Integer namesakeCount`) with getter/setter, matching the existing pattern for `customerCode`/`householdId`.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `namesakeCount` integer to the `Owner` schema. The DTO is generated from this at build time, and MapStruct maps it automatically by name (no mapper edits needed).

4. **DB schemas** — added `namesake_count INTEGER` to all four (`h2`, `hsqldb`, `mysql`, `postgres`) for consistency.

The `coreCountsNamesakes` acceptance test (two owners sharing name but differing address → second reports `namesakeCount = 1`) passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
